row.team_price_text: Launch: free to $180K ARR, then $49/month to $360K ARR (month-to-month)
row.evidence: Baremetrics prices on tracked ARR ('never by seat count, so you can invite your whole team') and adds team members by email invite in Settings > Team; no SCIM or SAML SSO appears on the pricing page, help centre or API reference.
row.notes: New row. Status 'none' by absence (rule 5, confidence medium). Pricing scales with tracked ARR, not seats: free up to $180K ARR, Launch $49/month to $360K ARR (month-to-month only), Growth from $69/month to $3.6M ARR, Scale from $409/month; annual plans up to 35% off. Per-user fields are null because pricing is not per seat. Unlimited team members on every plan, with Admin and User roles. No SAML/OIDC SSO is documented, so sso_plan is null. The REST API (the 'Analytics API', listed on Scale only in the pricing comparison) has read-only List Users and Show User endpoints for account team members; inviting, editing and removing users is UI-only.

auth.notes: Bearer token: an API key from Settings or an OAuth access token. Developers using the API must be admins.

citations.title: Baremetrics Pricing
citations.quote: Baremetrics is free while we're tracking up to $180K ARR for you. Above that, Launch is $49/month to $360K ARR. Growth starts at $69/month and scales with the revenue we track, up to $3.6M ARR. Scale starts at $409/month above that.
